requires_mcp_reason: agents/ampharos.md: the pipeline is local scripts plus OpenAI's image and responses APIs (OPENAI_API_KEY); no MCP server. Its reference images and oversized JSON indexes ship as Enact assets.
appendix: **Ampharos on Enact.** `<pipeline>` is `.claude/skills/prism-asset-pipeline` in your working directory; its art-direction files and reference images (`art-direction/references/…`) are there, and the Read tool shows you an image. `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set for you as a secret; `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` and `GEMINI_API_KEY` are not, so do the ideation yourself (as step 3 says when the Anthropic key is missing) and skip raster edits. Never print a key.

**Rendering here.** `gen.mjs` rasterizes SVG with Playwright resolved from `$PRISM_SITE_DIR`. When the run names the prismteam site repository, use its checkout after `npm ci` there. Otherwise make one: `mkdir -p ~/prism-site && cd ~/prism-site && npm init -y >/dev/null && npm i playwright && npx playwright install chromium`, then `export PRISM_SITE_DIR=~/prism-site`. If Chromium cannot start, say so and stop before painting.

**Showing and delivering.** The person sees only your text: they cannot open files in this sandbox, and `~/.prism-assets/runs` is gone when the session ends. For every preview and approval, push the images to a branch of the site repository the run names and open a draft pull request, then link the files. Exports after approval go in that pull request. If no repository is named or pushing is refused, stop at the plan and geometry, say the previews cannot be shown here, and ask for the site repository.

**Hard rules (rules/prism-assets.mdc).** Source of truth: `skills/prism-asset-pipeline/art-direction/art-direction.md`. Tokens: `art-direction/tokens.json`. System and vocabulary: `art-direction/system.json` (same directory); `lexicon.json` is superseded history.
Workflow entry point: `skills/prism-asset-pipeline/SKILL.md`. On Enact they are under `.claude/skills/` in the working directory.

Hard rules:
- Take the section copy, the emphasis, and depiction before a picture is planned. Show all three. Apply `system.json` `visual_slots.suggestion` in order. The first matching rule wins. Suggest exactly one of background, focus, or distinguishing per visual. Depiction does not choose the style. `user` puts a circle in the picture and the feeling happens to it. `us` puts a rounded square in the picture. `about_us` is the work or the system and may stay abstract. Then state the compositional layer separately. Flow is that layer, not a style. A section can have more than one visual, each with its own style. A stored suggestion does not skip the rule. Do not invent emphasis or depiction. Do not ignore a provided value. Run `visual_slots.selection`: the section copy proposes candidate elements, and the subject and the feeling decide which stay and how they interact. Article words do not propose candidates. One background can still underlie the page where a section's suggested style is background. Feeling versus explanation is per visual, not instead of style. Fail a focus visual that becomes a keyword diagram. Fail a feeling compositional flow mark that explains. Fail an explanation visual that only sets a mood. Fail `user` when there is no circle. Fail `us` when there is no rounded square.
- Reuse lexicon entries when meaning matches; propose new ones when the content requires; flag both for approval.
- When the copy argues a ceiling against a solution, the visuals must not mirror. The weaker side is visibly constrained.
- The `eclipse` token is geometry and type only. Never blurred.
- Geometry is exact SVG: 1.5 px non-scaling strokes, round caps. Never ask an image model for geometry. Focus rays come from gpt-image-2.5-sunburst and are composited under the SVG.
- Rendering: anything with a hard edge is one solid flat color; anything with a gradient is diffused light with soft edges. Light is smooth, never grain, noise, or texture.
- Line color is the graphic color of the ray that line meets (`system.json` `lines.colors`, same hexes as `shapes.graphic_colors`). The same darker color as the shape outline. Never the pale core, a ray fill, or a gradient.
- One construction: the light originates on a point of the geometry or on the scene element its `ray_role` names, and shares the angles that role sets. A power_source ray may trail behind the subject in any direction the motion implies. Other rays default to a fan angle, down and to the right. No ray runs level. A shape large enough to read as an outline has no fill. A shape small enough to read as a dot is filled with the graphic color of the ray it sits on. The stroke of a larger shape is that same graphic color (`system.json` `shapes.graphic_colors`), darker than that ray. The line uses that same graphic color. Place the geometry on the measured origin. Decide each ray's role before any light prompt (`system.json` `composition.jobs.light.role`). A ray is never placed at random. Do not attach Color Concept 04 as a reference image for focus rays.
- Type first: lay out headline, body, and CTA per breakpoint before the graphic. Recompose mobile; never crop desktop.
- Color harmony: the four Concept 04 pairs, chosen for harmony only. A composition may contain more than one ray. Each takes one job. When more than one is used, the ray that carries the claim is the hero, and the others support it. Place the shape by how it relates to the line. When the subject is associated with the path, leave about 16 pixels of ground between the shape's edge and the line. The line stays whole and passes beside the shape. When the shape is not associated with the line and reads as something that floats, the distance is whatever the composition needs. When the shape is the start or the end of the line, the line touches the shape's edge there and stops. That is the only time the line meets the shape. A shape that is the start or the end of the line is small and filled: a dot at the small-mark size, a circle about 5 to 7 percent of the desktop frame height, filled with the pair's graphic color, with no separate stroke. A large outline circle with no fill is only for a shape that is not connected to the line, one that sits beside the path or floats. A line enters from one edge of the frame and leaves through another, unless a shape is its start or its end. It does not begin or end in open ground. A composition may join more than one motif when the join is the situation.
- Mobile never ends a vertical element in a symmetric downward cone of light.
- Blurred light only via the construction rules in §2/§3. Visible ground between bands. No two adjacent shapes share a stroke color.
- No text baked into graphics. Labels are HTML, positioned from anchors in the brief.
- SVG filter IDs are prefixed `<section_id>-` and unique document-wide.
- No hardcoded hex. Read tokens.
- A graphic uses only the color pairs it already has. One mark uses one pair. Do not default to the full palette.
- Never infer construction, coordinates, or font metrics. Ask.
- Never write to `public/` without explicit approval.
- Never write generated runs into the plugin tree; use `$PRISM_RUNS_DIR` (default `~/.prism-assets/runs`).
- When an output is corrected, update the skill or brief that caused it.
